summary: Banco Bradesco furnished a 6-K disclosing its board's September 30, 2026 approval of interim interest on shareholders' equity (the Brazilian analog to a special dividend) totaling R$3.8 billion, or R$0.342389810 per common and R$0.376628790 per preferred share, with withholding tax of 17.5% applied except for exempt legal entities. Record date is October 13, 2026, ex-date October 14, 2026, with payment by April 30, 2027, qualifying toward mandatory dividends. No premium or M&A mechanics apply; watch payout timing, foreign-holder tax treatment, and follow-on capital-return signals.
